title: Clean-checkout and multiprocess terminal-ledger readiness v1

proposal_scope.title: Clean-checkout and multiprocess terminal-ledger readiness v1
proposal_scope.hypothesis: The EXP014-approved research stack can be reproduced from tracked files only and can commit exactly one immutable terminal shadow decision per registered synthetic race under bounded simultaneous multi-process contention, crash/restart boundaries, and concurrent summary rebuilds without candidate mutation, odds access, or safety-flag drift.
proposal_scope.null_hypothesis: A tracked-only checkout cannot reproduce the stack, or simultaneous processes can deadlock, silently lose a race, append duplicate or conflicting decisions, leave an unrecoverable marker, corrupt the ledger, rebuild a divergent summary, call odds before terminal failure handling, or change a safety flag.
proposal_scope.racing_mechanism: A valid pre-race candidate has no evidential value unless the race-day system records one timely and immutable decision for every target race. Concurrent workers, restart supervision, and shared-ledger contention can selectively drop or duplicate races, bias the prospective denominator, and invalidate later calibration and ROI evidence even when the probability model is unchanged.
proposal_scope.target_population: Fifteen pre-registered deterministic synthetic cases executed against the approved EXP014 stacked research path, including a tracked-only git-archive checkout and bounded Windows/Linux spawn-based multi-process contention. Real schedules, races, odds, results, payouts, ROI, credentials, notifications, and orders are excluded.
out_of_scope: Any actual race-day filesystem latency, provider latency, process supervision SLO, or production readiness claim
Any dashboard, notification, credential, target handoff, purchase adapter, formal BUY, nonzero stake, or order transmission

Any real schedule source, live JRA page, quote request, odds parsing, starter-universe feed, result join, payout, ROI, or backtest
Any weakening of candidate freeze, schedule chronology, strict T-3, quote freshness, denominator, or append-only contracts
raw_data_sources: Tracked files from the future canonical EXP015 execution commit exported with git archive
rejection_gate: Any candidate identity, probability, confidence result, pair, ticket type, or action threshold changes
Any conflicting record is accepted under the same idempotency key
Any corrupt marker or truncated ledger tail is silently accepted
Any odds, popularity, market, result, payout, ROI, credential, notification, or order path is accessed
Any production, dashboard, notification, purchase, formal BUY, nonzero stake, or order side effect occurs
Any registered race is missing or has more than one terminal decision
Any spawned process deadlocks or exceeds the fixed bounded test deadline
Any summary differs from the verified decision ledger
Any tracked-only archive requires an ignored, untracked, credential, or external production file
stop_conditions: A credential, login challenge, CAPTCHA, access restriction, protected endpoint, or order-capable path is encountered
A model, feature, calibrator, candidate, confidence, value, ticket, or BUY-policy change would be required
A real schedule, odds, starter-universe feed, result, payout, or production source would need to be accessed
Any safety flag cannot remain false or stake cannot remain zero
The existing candidate, schedule chronology, strict T-3, quote freshness, denominator, or append-only contract would need to be weakened
lineage_hash_requirements: A marker may suppress a new append only when a matching hash-valid decision already exists
Concurrent and restart recovery never change candidate identity, probability, confidence result, pair, or action threshold
Every output retains candidate_uses_odds false, formal_buy false, send_order false, and stake zero
Every summary is rebuilt from the verified append-only decision ledger and cannot become its source of truth
Every terminal decision retains the frozen candidate record hash and deterministic experiment/cohort/race idempotency key
The clean-checkout rehearsal must use a git archive of the exact canonical execution commit and reject ignored or untracked inputs
The execution branch must contain approved EXP014 shadow commit 8e02b8575f57c33fc95f2d5df542e9dd3267f7f8 as an ancestor
in_scope: Add one research-only bounded cross-process lock acquisition contract for terminal decision persistence
Exercise crash and process-exit boundaries around marker creation, append, and summary rebuild
Exercise distinct-race workers sharing one ledger and a fixed twelve-race synthetic card
Exercise simultaneous identical and conflicting writes against one shared append-only decision ledger
Fail closed on bounded lock timeout, corrupt markers, and truncated ledger tails
Rebuild summaries concurrently and verify that every summary matches the verified decision ledger
Repeat the fixed stress case twenty times and compare the canonical terminal-record set
Run only the fifteen pre-registered synthetic cases during preparation
Run the fixed research suite from a git-archive extraction containing tracked files only
proposal_scope.data_as_of: 2026-08-03T00:11:32+09:00. Proposal construction uses only the EXP014-approved stacked research implementation, its review evidence, tracked repository files, and deterministic synthetic fixtures. Real schedules, odds, results, payouts, ROI, credentials, and production sources are forbidden.

chronological_fold_design.design: One deterministic synthetic integration suite with fifteen pre-registered cases; no fitting, fold selection, model comparison, threshold search, ROI calculation, or real-data access.
chronological_fold_design.candidate_clock: Each synthetic candidate is already frozen and hash-verified before schedule preflight or persistence contention begins.
chronological_fold_design.schedule_clock: Only deterministic synthetic schedule locks or pre-terminal failures are used; no real schedule observation is read.
chronological_fold_design.persistence_clock: Spawned processes contend at fixed barriers around lock acquisition, marker creation, ledger append, and summary rebuild.
chronological_fold_design.odds_clock: The synthetic worker receives an odds callback that fails the case if invoked before a terminal pre-quote decision.
chronological_fold_design.denominator_rule: Every registered synthetic race must appear exactly once in the verified terminal decision ledger after bounded contention and recovery.
chronological_fold_design.clean_checkout_rule: The canonical execution commit is exported with git archive and the fixed suite is invoked from that tracked-only extraction.
chronological_fold_design.real_data_rule: APPROVED_TO_PREPARE permits implementation preparation and synthetic fixtures only.

purge_embargo.candidate_embargo: No candidate may be created, replaced, re-ranked, or removed by contention or recovery logic.
purge_embargo.schedule_embargo: No schedule version received after its implied cutoff may be applied retrospectively.
purge_embargo.quote_embargo: No odds or market field is available to the fixtures or pre-terminal recovery path.
purge_embargo.result_embargo: No result, payout, final odds, or ROI information is available to implementation or fixtures.

primary_metric.name: pre_registered_clean_checkout_and_concurrency_case_pass_fraction
primary_metric.baseline: EXP014 passed deterministic single-process restart and duplicate-invocation tests but explicitly left simultaneous multi-process lock contention and tracked-only clean-checkout reproduction unverified.
primary_metric.evaluation: Fraction of the fifteen fixed cases satisfying their exact terminal, integrity, timeout, clean-checkout, and safety expectations, with no deadlock, missing race, duplicate decision, ledger corruption, odds callback, or summary mismatch.

notes: Tracked-only integration and bounded multiprocess persistence readiness; synthetic-only and no real-data or BUY authority.
